title: events/types/mutation.candidate
description: Payload for event_type 'mutation.candidate' (feature 016; FR-1408/1410): a gated mutation materialized as a candidate pack file under packs/candidates/ and recorded pending for the next run boundary. A candidate is data — it carries no dispatch authority.

hash.description: Canonical-JSON hash of the candidate document.

target_pack.description: Pack file id the candidate would install over at the next boundary.

mutation_id.description: Source proposal id when model-authored; null for rules-only remediations.
